name: Dalewood I II & III Shopping Center

description: Dalewood I, II & III Shopping Center is a premier 196,148 square foot community shopping center strategically located on North Central Avenue in Hartsdale, New York, serving as a cornerstone retail destination in lower Westchester County. The center boasts an impressive lineup of national retailers including H Mart, Barnes & Noble, T.J. Maxx, Ulta Beauty, J.Crew Factory, and Shake Shack, drawing an estimated 4.9 million annual visits that rank it among the top 10% of community shopping centers in New York State. Currently undergoing an exciting redevelopment, the center will welcome Best Buy and Sprouts Farmers Market by the end of 2026, further enhancing its already strong tenant mix. With high visibility from over 23,000 vehicles daily on Central Avenue and close proximity to White Plains Hospital and New York-Presbyterian medical facilities, the center benefits from both strong residential traffic and a robust daytime population. The property serves one of the most affluent trade areas in the region, with average household incomes exceeding $217,400 within 3 miles, making it an ideal destination for quality-focused retailers and dining establishments.
